# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 20 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Michael Tells Seth to Return; Adam's Consolation

---

**1** 'Return to your father,' Michael said to Seth. 'Today his soul will leave his body and go to be with God.'

**2** He gave Seth three olive branches and said: 'Take these to your father Adam. When he dies, place them in his mouth. From these branches the tree of mercy will grow.'

**3** Seth headed home, carrying the three branches. Eve wept all the way.

**4** When they arrived, Adam saw the three branches and said: 'Son, what message did Michael give you?' Seth told him everything.

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
